input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5's warranties are limited to legal compliance, authority/rights, non-infringement and anti-bribery; there is no express warranty that the Services or Works will conform to the Specifications, no warranty period (whether 12 months, 90 days or 30 days), and no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy. Section 1(b) requires performance in a professional and workmanlike manner in accordance with industry standards, which covers only one preferred element, and the Section 4 "ACCEPTANCE" heading has no operative acceptance or cure mechanic. Because the disclaimer in 5(e) also strips implied warranties (merchantability, fitness), Clear Capital is left with no conformance warranty at all — below the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies). We therefore insert a 90-day conformance warranty with a re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedy, a no-malicious-code warranty, and an express confirmation that 5(e) does not cut back these express warranties.

proposal.summary: Add express performance/conformance warranty with 90-day period and re-performance, repair/replacement or refund remedy
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains no express warranty that the Services or Works will conform to the Specifications and no remedy for non-conforming work, so we have added our standard 90-day conformance warranty with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund. We can accept a 30-day period for Services as a fallback if needed.

ops.text: Contractor represents and warrants to Company that (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (ii) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Work (including any software deliverable) will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and documentation; and (iii) the Works will not contain any virus, malicious code or other disabling device. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Work, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or Work. The disclaimer in Paragraph 5(e) does not limit the express warranties set forth in this Paragraph 5.
